name: p3.4_key_specificity

params.embedding: post-hoc W + alpha * P_K^T * S on the carrier (P3.2)
params.alphas_note: fixed before running; not a selection; accuracy not measured (P3.5)

wrong_keys.derivation: SHA-256('zk-crown/p3.4/wrong-key/v1' || u64 seed || u64 j), public, never K
wrong_keys.each_derives: its own P_K' and S' for the same owner id

params.z: correlation * sqrt(128); a scale, not a p-value

notes: Key specificity of the weight watermark on real hosts, post-hoc embedding. No threshold or p-value: the null distribution and threshold are P3.7. Accuracy of the embedded models is not measured (P3.5). Aggregates only; S, P_K, fingerprints and watermarked weights are not in this file.
